title: Day 5 — Full Mock: Bug + Feature + PR
skill: Run the full human-led, AI-assisted loop end to end: comprehend, fix a bug, ship a feature, open a PR, self-review.
prompt: Ticket PRICE-214: a $20 coupon on a $100 cart charged $88.00 — finance expected $86.40. And we need a bulk discount. Here's the pricing engine. Walk me through your plan, then fix and ship it.

clarifications.answer: The bug: a fixed-dollar coupon is applied AFTER tax. It must be subtracted from the subtotal BEFORE tax.
A coupon larger than the cart must not produce a negative total — floor at 0.
Feature: any line with quantity >= 10 gets 10% off that line, applied before coupon and tax.
Round the final total to 2 decimals.
Order of operations: bulk discount per line -> subtotal -> subtract coupon -> apply tax -> round.
Change only pricing.py; then write the PR description and self-review checklist (that's the ownership signal).

hints: Read pricing.py and write down the current order of operations in total() — the bug is in that order.
Coupon (fixed $) comes off the subtotal before tax; guard the total at max(0, ...).
Bulk: in subtotal(), if a line's qty >= BULK_THRESHOLD multiply that line by (1 - BULK_DISCOUNT).
